summary: Frontend-only verification of the new hero-wipe keyframe animation on all 5 industry sub-pages. Animation runs on mount, mid-flight clip-path (inset(0 100% 0 0) or similar) observed, and final state fully revealed (clip-path inset(0px), naturalWidth>0) on every page at both 1920x900 and 1280x900. Homepage 'Security by Design' image regression check passed. Industry hero sections remain natural height.
critical_code_review_comments: hero-wipe uses animation fill-mode 'both' with will-change clip-path — correct; coexists cleanly with live-float transform and opacity-80 (construction).

ImageReveal still ends up adding 'img-reveal is-in' to hero-wipe elements (seen in LATE class list). Not harmful (clip-path stays inset(0px)) but suggests the ':not(.hero-wipe)' exclusion in ImageReveal.jsx may not be filtering as intended for all hero images. Consider verifying the scanner selector.
context_for_next_testing_agent: hero-wipe keyframe animation verified across all 5 industry sub-pages at 1920x900 and 1280x900. Mid-flight clip-path confirmed on NP and HC; others cycled too fast to catch mid-state but all end fully revealed with naturalWidth>0. One minor observation: ImageReveal still appends 'img-reveal is-in' classes to hero-wipe images despite the :not(.hero-wipe) exclusion — no visible impact but worth a code-level check.
